name: deck-pitch
tagline_zh: 10页融资deck，白底蓝紫渐变hero，traction柱状图，$X.XM ask——别家模板只会套话。
tagline_en: 10-slide pitch deck with white bg, blue-purple hero, traction bars, and $X.XM ask—no generic fluff, just.
desc_en: 10 页融资 deck, 白底 + 蓝紫渐变 hero, traction 柱状, $X.XM ask
why_zh: 它把融资叙事拆成固定结构，连ask金额都替你排版好，比从零画快十倍，且每页都踩在投资人预期上。
why_en: It bakes the investor narrative into a fixed 10-slide structure, even formatting your ask—so you skip blank-page panic and pitch.
